name: Error
intro: The Error pathway exploits loopholes, theft, deception and the flaws in supernatural rules. Its strength grows through misdirection, parasitism and abnormal interference.

meter.name: Theft
meter.spend: Steal an observed ability from Sequence 6
meter.full: Deny its owner one turn and retain one paid use

ability.name: Combat Theft
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Combat Theft — Lowers target ATK by 15% and raises your own ATK by 15% for 2 turns; Lowers target DEF by 15% and raises your own DEF by 15% for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Deceptive Feint
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Deceptive Feint — Deals 110% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); Forces the target's next damaging action to miss with 100% chance; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 20 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Rust Siphon
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Rust Siphon — Deals 140% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Corrosion damage (22% base DEF bypass); At 100 charge, steal one witnessed ability from Sequence 6: deny its owner access for 1 turn and gain one normally paid use.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Logic Distortion
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Logic Distortion — Distort one enemy's next paid damaging ability to target its own side, once within 2 turns; normal SP, cooldown, damage and hit rules remain. Confusion immunity and mental resistance apply.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Parasitic Contagion
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Parasitic Contagion — Attach one parasite from Sequence 4 for 2 turns; on each host turn siphon 20 SP plus 10% of the host's Max SP (limited to the SP the host has) and recover 4% Max HP when SP is drained; total recovery from all hosts is capped at 4% owner Max HP per round. A new cast moves the parasite. At 100 charge, Contagion attaches it to every enemy and refreshes existing parasites; against a lone enemy it drains 50% more.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Deceive Impact
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Deceive Impact — Negates incoming direct hits and reflects 100% of incoming damage to the attacker until your next turn; periodic damage does not trigger reflection; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 70 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Steal Destiny & Turn
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Steal Destiny & Turn — Removes current stat buffs, Guarded, Evade and shields; +25% ATK for 2 turns; +25% INT for 2 turns; Grants 1 extra action if you and the current enemy survive; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Time Theft
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Time Theft — 100% chance: Stunned (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Grants 1 extra action if you and the current enemy survive; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Systemic Glitch
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Systemic Glitch — Deals 420% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Removes up to 30% enemy Max HP and restores the amount removed to you; cannot kill by this siphon; Lowers target ATK by 30% and raises your own ATK by 30% for 2 turns; Removes current stat buffs, Guarded, Evade and shields; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
